title.description: At most 60 characters of letters, digits and ` _.,:/()+=-`; others are dropped. Not `direction` and TB, TD, BT, RL or LR; in a state diagram not `::`, `_` opening or closing a word, `www.`, `http://`, `https://` or `ftp://`, nor a transition ending with `:`; a sequence's participants without `,` or `:`, and its messages not starting `wrap:`, `nowrap:`, `:wrap:` or `:nowrap:`.

at.description: The full commit ID of the code the citations name.

planned.description: The plan item that adds it, such as P1.S3, where it is not yet in the code; else null.

edges.description: At most 60; a sequence's in the order they happen.

path.description: Relative to the top of the repository.

endLine.description: The last line of a span of at most 200, or null.

symbol.description: A whole word in the lines: a node's declaration, a call edge's callee, a transition's target state.
